pool.text: Chiang Mai was founded as the new capital of Lan Na, succeeding Chiang Rai.
Wat Phra Singh within the city walls dates from this time.
Wat Chedi Luang was founded, dominated by a large Lanna style chedi.
Chiang Mai lost importance with Lan Na decline and was occupied by Toungoo.
Chiang Mai formally became part of the Thonburi Kingdom by an agreement.
First Church was founded by the Laos Mission of the Rev.
The modern municipality dates to a sanitary district that was created.
Chiang Mai became the first City Municipality in Thailand under Siam.
The city area was enlarged for the first and last time.
Average PM10 rates peaked at 383 micrograms per cubic metre.
IBM launched its Smarter Cities Challenge program studying local urban issues.
Chiang Mai was named on TripAdvisor's list of 25 Best Destinations in the World.
MAIIAM Contemporary Art Museum, a museum of contemporary art, opened.
Chiang Mai was declared by UNESCO Creative Cities Network for Crafts.
Chiang Mai launched Mobike In bike-sharing app with smart bikes.
British newspaper The Independent wrote an article about Chiang Mai vegan capital.
Chiang Mai offers a citywide bus system named RTC Chiang Mai City Bus.
The Chiang Mai Municipality released a flock of geese into the moat.
